阿.definition: an initial particle, a prefix used for names; used in transliterations
阿.note: 阝 place + 可 kě (sound). A prefix, and a sound in foreign names: 阿拉伯 Ālābó = Arab.

拉.definition: to pull, to drag; to seize, to hold; to lengthen; to play (a violin)
拉.note: 扌 hand + 立 lì (sound). To pull, which you do with your hand.

伯.definition: older brother; father's elder brother; sir, sire, count
伯.note: 亻 person + 白 bái (sound). Here only for its sound, in 阿拉伯 (Arab).

文.note: Picture of a person with a pattern on the chest. Patterns became "writing, culture". As a suffix: a written language (法文).

语.note: 讠 speech + 吾 wú (sound). Anything with 讠 is about words and language.

啊.note: 口 mouth + 阿 ā (sound). A sound you make with your mouth: ah!

八.note: Two strokes parting from each other (old meaning: to divide), borrowed for "eight".

吧.note: 口 mouth + 巴 bā (sound). A mouth-sound that softens a sentence into a suggestion.

把.definition: to grasp, to hold; to guard, to take; handle
把.note: 扌 hand + 巴 bā (sound). To grasp; measure word for things held by a handle.

爸.note: 父 father on top + 巴 bā (sound) below.

etymology.hint: A burning candle; the rays of the sun

白.note: Picture of a flame or the sun's rays: bright, white.

百.note: 一 one + 白 bái (sound): a hundred.

etymology.hint: Cutting 刂 a piece of jade 王 in two, symbolizing two classes

班.note: A knife 刂 splitting jade 王 into two: dividing into groups, a class.

办.definition: to set up; to manage, to run; to deal with, to handle
办.note: 力 strength with two drops of sweat: to handle, to get things done.

etymology.hint: To divide 八 what is private 厶

公.note: 八 divide + 厶 private: sharing out what was private = public, fair.

室.note: 宀 roof + 至 zhì (sound): a room.

etymology.hint: To swaddle 勹 a baby 巳; 勹 also provides the pronunciation

包.note: 勹 wrapping around 巳 a baby: to wrap.

子.definition: son, child; seed, egg; fruit; small thing

etymology.hint: A child in a wrap, with outstretched arms but bundled legs

子.note: Picture of a baby with arms out and legs wrapped. Also a common noun ending (包子, 饺子).

杯.definition: cup, glass; measure word for liquids
杯.note: 木 wood (early cups were wooden) + 不 bù (sound): cup.

etymology.hint: A tree 木 with its roots highlighted

本.note: 木 tree with a mark at the roots: root, origin; measure word for books.

etymology.hint: Two spoons 匕 side-by-side; 匕 also provides the pronunciation

比.note: Two people (匕) standing side by side: to compare.

较.note: 车 cart + 交 jiāo (sound): to compare.

笔.definition: pen, pencil, writing brush; to compose, to write; Hanzi stroke

etymology.hint: A bamboo rod ⺮ tipped with hair 毛

笔.note: ⺮ bamboo + 毛 hair: a bamboo brush tipped with hair, a pen.

别.definition: to separate, to distinguish, to classify; to leave; other; do not, must not

etymology.hint: To draw boundaries 刂 between classes 另

别.note: 另 another + 刂 knife: cut apart, separate, other.

的.definition: aim, goal; of; possessive particle; -self suffix
的.note: 白 + 勺. Originally "target"; now the most common particle: 我的 = mine.

etymology.hint: A bird flying toward the sky 一

不.note: Just remember it as "no, not". It turns into bú before a 4th tone (bú shì).

etymology.hint: A person 各 welcomed under one's roof 宀; 各 also provides the pronunciation

客.note: 宀 roof + 各 gè (sound): someone under your roof, a guest.

气.note: Picture of vapor rising in layers: air, breath, gas.

茶.note: 艹 plant on top, 人 person in the middle, 木 tree below: the tea plant.

叶.note: Simplified from 葉, leaf. 口 + 十 (just shapes here).

车.definition: cart, vehicle; to move in a cart

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 車, a cart with two wheels, seen from above

车.note: Simplified picture of a cart seen from above: axle and two wheels.

吃.definition: to eat; to drink; to suffer, to endure, to bear
吃.note: 口 mouth + 乞 qǐ (sound): to eat.

出.definition: to go out, to send out; stand; produce

etymology.hint: A sprout 屮 growing out of a container 凵

出.note: A sprout growing out of a container: to go out.

租.definition: to rent, to lease; tax, rent

etymology.hint: Regularly paid 且 tribute in grain 禾

租.note: 禾 grain + 且 qiě (sound). Rent was once paid in grain.

词.note: 讠 speech + 司 sī (sound): a word.

etymology.hint: Two hands 八 holding a book 冊

典.note: Old books (bamboo slips 曲) laid on a stand: a classic, a standard book.

etymology.hint: A man 人 with outstretched arms

大.note: A person with arms spread wide: big.

概.note: 木 + 既 jì (sound): general, approximately.

学.definition: learning, knowledge, science; to study, to go to school; -ology

etymology.hint: A building 冖 where children 子 study; ⺍ provides the pronunciation

学.note: Hands (⺍) and a roof (冖) over a child 子: a child learning under a roof.

etymology.hint: A man 大 wearing a coming-of-age hairpin 一

夫.note: 大 a grown man with a hairpin 一 across the head: an adult man.

但.note: 亻 person + 旦 dàn (sound, same as the word).

是.definition: to be; indeed, right, yes; okay

etymology.hint: To speak 日 directly 疋

是.note: 日 on top of 疋. Just remember: 是 = to be.

蛋.note: 疋 + 虫 creature at the bottom: an egg, which creatures lay.

德.note: 彳 walk + 十 and 罒 (an eye) + 一 + 心 heart: straight eyes and heart, virtue.

等.definition: rank, grade; same, equal; to wait

etymology.hint: Bamboo strips ⺮ laid before a court 寺

等.note: ⺮ bamboo + 寺 sì: bamboo slips sorted by rank. Means "grade" and "to wait".

弟.note: A cord wound around a stick, in order: order of birth, younger brother.

etymology.hint: Represents heaven (天), earth (旦), or the number 1

一.note: One stroke = one. Its tone changes: yí before a 4th tone (yígòng), yì before others (yìxiē).

点.note: 占 zhàn (sound) + 灬 fire dots: a dot. Also "o'clock" (三点).

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 兒, a picture of a child; compare 人

儿.note: Picture of a person's legs: child. As a suffix it adds an "r": 哪儿 nǎr.

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 電; lightning 申 from a storm cloud 雨

电.note: Lightning striking through a field: electricity.

etymology.hint: A spoken 讠 tongue 舌; 舌 also provides the pronunciation

话.note: 讠 speech + 舌 tongue: words, speech.

都.definition: all, each, entirely, whole; metropolis; capital
都.note: 者 zhě (sound) + 阝 city: first meant a capital city (dū); now mostly "all" (dōu).

读.definition: to study, to learn; to read, to pronounce

etymology.hint: To show off 卖 one's literacy 讠

读.note: 讠 speech + 卖. Memory hook: reading aloud like a market seller calling out.

etymology.hint: A pair 又 of hands 寸

对.note: 又 hand + 寸 hand: two hands facing each other, facing, correct.

起.definition: to begin, to initiate; to rise, to stand up
起.note: 走 walk + 己 jǐ (sound): to rise, to get up.

多.definition: much, many, multi-; more than, over
多.note: Two 夕 stacked: more and more, many.

etymology.hint: Grains of sand; 小 provides the pronunciation and meaning

少.note: 小 small + one more stroke: even less, few.

俄.note: 亻 person + 我 wǒ (sound). Used for Russia (俄国).

etymology.hint: Two  parallel lines; compare 一 (one) and 三 (three)

发.definition: to issue, to dispatch, to send out; hair
发.note: Simplified from 發 "to send out" (and 髮 "hair"). 发音 = send out a sound.

etymology.hint: A tongue 立 forming a sound in the mouth 日

音.note: 立 on top of 日: a tongue making a sound in the mouth.

法.definition: law, rule, statute; method, way; French

etymology.hint: The course 去 followed by a stream 氵

法.note: 氵 water + 去 go: water always follows its course, a law, a method.

饭.note: 饣 food + 反 fǎn (sound): a meal, cooked rice.

房.note: 户 door + 方 fāng (sound): a house, a room.

间.definition: between, among; midpoint; space, place, locality

etymology.hint: The sun 日 shining through a doorway 门

间.note: 日 sun shining through 门 a doorway: a gap, a space between, a room.

分.definition: to divide, to allocate; fraction; small unit of time or other quantity

etymology.hint: Pieces 八 being further subdivided with a knife 刀

分.note: 八 divide + 刀 knife: to divide; a small unit (a cent, a minute).

刚.note: 冈 gāng (sound) + 刂 knife: hard; as an adverb, "just now".

港.note: 氵 water + 巷 xiàng: a harbor. 香港 = Hong Kong.

币.note: 巾 cloth (money was once written on silk): currency.

高.note: Picture of a tall tower: tall, high.

兴.definition: to thrive, to prosper, to flourish
兴.note: Hands lifting something together: to rise, to be in high spirits.

etymology.hint: One person talking 可 over another 可

哥.note: Two 可 stacked. Sound gē: elder brother.

个.definition: this, that; single; measure word for individuals

etymology.hint: A tally 丨 of people 人

个.note: A person 人 with a stroke under it: counting one by one, the general measure word.

给.definition: to give, to lend; for, by
给.note: 纟 silk + 合 hé: silk was a common gift, to give.

etymology.hint: A spade or other workman's tool

工.note: Picture of a carpenter's square: work.

作.definition: to make; to write, to compose; to act, to perform

etymology.hint: A person 亻 making something for the first time 乍; 乍 also provides the pronunciation

作.note: 亻 person + 乍 zhà (sound): to make, to do.

斤.definition: a catty (about 500 grams); an axe; keen, shrewd
斤.note: Picture of an axe; used as a weight unit (half a kilo).

司.definition: to take charge of, to control, to manage; officer

etymology.hint: A person speaking orders 口 and raising their arm

司.note: A person giving orders with the mouth 口: to manage.

贵.note: 贝 shell (old money) at the bottom: costly, precious.

姓.definition: name, family name, surname; clan, people
姓.note: 女 woman + 生 shēng (born): the clan name passed down from the mother, a surname.

etymology.hint: Treasure 玉 within a country's borders 囗

国.note: 囗 borders around 玉 treasure: a country.

还.definition: also, besides; still, yet; to return
还.note: 辶 walk + 不. Read hái: still, also. Read huán: to give back.

韩.note: Left part + 韦 wéi (sound). Used for Korea (韩国).

etymology.hint: A man 儿 with two lines emphasizing their head 二

元.note: 二 two lines over 儿 a person, marking the head: first, origin; also a unit of money.

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 漢; the Han 𦰩 river 氵

汉.note: 氵 water + 又. The Han River, then the Han people, then "Chinese".

etymology.hint: A child 子 in a house 宀; 子 also provides the pronunciation

字.note: 宀 roof + 子 zǐ child (sound and meaning): a written character.

好.definition: good, excellent, fine; proper, suitable; well

etymology.hint: A woman 女 with a son 子

好.note: 女 woman + 子 child: a mother with her child, good.

久.note: A person held back from behind: a long time.

号.definition: mark, sign; symbol; number; to call, to cry, to roar
号.note: 口 mouth + 丂: to call out, then a number.

码.note: 石 stone + 马 mǎ (sound): stones used for counting, a number.

喝.definition: to drink; to shout, to call out
喝.note: 口 mouth + 曷 hé (sound): to drink.

和.note: 禾 grain + 口 mouth: grain for every mouth, harmony; also "and".

etymology.hint: A man's face blacked by soot from a fire 灬

黑.note: A face blackened by soot over a fire 灬: black.

很.note: 彳 step + 艮 gèn (sound): very.

红.definition: red, vermillion; to blush, to flush; popular
红.note: 纟 silk + 工 gōng (sound): red, the color of dyed silk.

欢.note: 又 hand + 欠 open mouth: joyful.

迎.definition: to welcome, to receive, to greet
迎.note: 辶 walk + 卬 áng (sound): to walk out to meet, to welcome.

换.definition: to change; to exchange, to swap, to trade
换.note: 扌 hand + 奂 huàn (sound): to exchange by hand.

回.definition: to return, to turn around; a time
回.note: A small box inside a big one (originally a spiral): to return.

etymology.hint: Another 又 kind of bird 鸟

几.definition: small table; how many; a few, some
几.note: Picture of a small table. Borrowed for "how many? a few".

寄.definition: to mail, to send, to transit; to deposit, to entrust; to rely on
寄.note: 宀 roof + 奇 qí (sound): to send, to mail.

家.note: 宀 roof over 豕 a pig (families kept pigs at home): home.

见.definition: to see, to observe, to meet, to appear

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 見; a man 儿 with the eye 目 emphasized

见.note: Simplified 見: a person 儿 with a big eye on top, to see.

件.definition: item, matter; component, part; measure word for events

etymology.hint: A man 亻 dividing up a cow 牛

件.note: 亻 person + 牛 ox: a man cutting an ox into pieces, an item.

etymology.hint: A rhinoceros or other animal horn

角.note: Picture of an animal horn: horn, corner; 1/10 of a yuan.

毛.note: Picture of a feather or hair: hair, fur; spoken word for jiao.

饺.note: 饣 food + 交 jiāo (sound): dumpling.

叫.definition: cry, shout; to call, to greet, to hail
叫.note: 口 mouth + 丩: to shout, to call; to be called.

教.note: 孝 + 攵 a hand holding a stick: to teach.

授.definition: to award, to confer, to instruct, to teach
授.note: 扌 hand + 受 shòu (sound, same): to hand over, to teach.

姐.note: 女 woman + 且 qiě (sound): elder sister.

介.definition: agent, go-between, intermediary; to introduce; shell, armor

etymology.hint: A border 八 dividing people 人

介.note: A person 人 between two lines: in between, a go-between.

绍.note: 纟 thread + 召 zhào (sound): to link up.

etymology.hint: A mouth 亼 talking about things

今.note: A lid over a line: now, the present.

etymology.hint: The heavens 一 above a man 大

天.note: 一 sky above 大 a person: sky, day.

进.definition: to advance, to make progress; to come in, to enter
进.note: 辶 walk + 井 jǐng (sound): to go in.

经.definition: the classics; to experience, to undergo
经.note: 纟 thread + 𢀖: the warp threads of a loom; to pass through, to manage.

理.note: 王 jade + 里 lǐ (sound): the veins of jade, reason, to manage.

九.note: Picture of a bent arm: nine.

etymology.hint: A jar 酉 of wine 氵; 酉 also provides the pronunciation

酒.note: 氵 liquid + 酉 a wine jar: alcohol.

etymology.hint: Older than 丨 the sun 日

旧.note: 丨 + 日 (simplified from 舊): old, used.

橘.note: 木 tree + 矞: tangerine tree.

觉.definition: conscious; to nap, to sleep; to wake up
觉.note: 见 see under a roof with marks on top: to feel, to be aware.

得.definition: to obtain, to get, to acquire; suitable, proper; ready

etymology.hint: A hand 寸 grabbing a shell 旦

得.note: 彳 step + 旦 + 寸 hand: to obtain. Light syllable in 觉得 (juéde).

咖.note: 口 mouth + 加 jiā (sound): only for sound, in 咖啡 coffee.

啡.note: 口 mouth + 非 fēi (sound): only for sound, in 咖啡 coffee.

开.definition: to open; to start, to initiate, to begin

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 開; hands 廾 lifting the latch 一 of a door

开.note: Two hands lifting the bar of a gate: to open, to start.

看.definition: to look, to see; to examine, to scrutinize

etymology.hint: Shielding one's eyes 目 with a hand 手 to look to the distance

看.note: 手 hand over 目 eye: shading your eyes to look far.

口.note: Picture of an open mouth. Measure word for family members.

块.definition: piece, lump, chunk; dollar; measure word for currency
块.note: 土 earth + 夬: a lump, a piece; spoken word for yuan.

来.definition: to arrive, to come, to return; in the future, later on

etymology.hint: A wheat plant that has not yet borne fruit; compare 來

来.note: Picture of a wheat plant, borrowed for "to come".

蓝.note: 艹 plant + 监 jiān: the indigo plant, blue.

etymology.hint: A person bent over with long hair 匕 and a crutch; compare 耂

老.note: An old person bent over, with long hair and a cane: old.

etymology.hint: To skillfully wield 帀 a knife 刂

里.definition: unit of distance equal to 0.5km; village; lane

etymology.hint: Unit of measure for farm 田 land 土

里.note: 田 field + 土 earth: a village; also "inside".

etymology.hint: A couple 寿; 寿 also provides the pronunciation

俩.note: 亻 person + 两 liǎng two: two people.

etymology.hint: Two people 从 together in a cart

两.note: Two people 从 under one frame: two, a pair.

etymology.hint: Two 两 carts 车; 两 also provides the pronunciation

辆.note: 车 vehicle + 两 liǎng (sound): measure word for vehicles.

零.note: 雨 rain + 令 lìng (sound): small drops, a remainder, zero.

〇.note: A round zero, used when writing numbers with characters (二〇二六).

留.definition: to stay, to remain; to preserve, to keep; to leave a message;
留.note: 卯 + 田 field: to stay, to keep.

etymology.hint: A shoot 屮 growing in the soil 土

生.note: A plant sprouting from the ground: to be born, life.

楼.note: 木 wood + 娄 lóu (sound): a building with floors.

etymology.hint: To walk 彳 as required by law 聿

律.note: 彳 walk + 聿 a writing brush: written rules to walk by, law.

妈.note: 女 woman + 马 mǎ (sound): mom.

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 馬, a horse galloping to the left

马.note: Simplified picture of a horse: mane, legs, tail.

etymology.hint: A tiger 虍 standing on a rock 几; 虍 also provides the pronunciation

虎.note: 虍 tiger's head on top: tiger.

吗.note: 口 mouth + 马 mǎ (sound): the question particle.

买.definition: to buy, to purchase; to bribe, to persuade
买.note: Simplified from 買 (a net over 贝 money): to buy.

卖.definition: to sell; to betray; to show off
卖.note: 买 buy with 十 on top: to sell (one extra piece on top).

馒.note: 饣 food + 曼 màn (sound): steamed bun.

etymology.hint: A heart 忄 faced with death 亡; 亡 also provides the pronunciation

忙.note: 忄 heart + 亡 wáng (sound, "lost"): a lost heart, too busy.

没.definition: not, none, gone; to bury; to sink, to drown
没.note: 氵 water + 殳: sunk under water, gone, not have.

有.definition: to have, to own, to possess; to exist
有.note: A hand holding meat 月: to have.

关.definition: frontier pass; to close, to shut; relation
关.note: The bolts of a gate: to close; a connection.

系.note: Silk threads 糸 hanging down: to tie, a link.

etymology.hint: A file of ten 十 people 亻

什.note: 亻 + 十: in 什么 "what".

么.note: A light syllable in 什么 and 怎么.

etymology.hint: A person 大 wearing an elegant crown 羊

美.note: 羊 a headdress on 大 a person: beautiful.

妹.note: 女 woman + 未 wèi (sound): younger sister.

门.note: Picture of a doorway: door, gate.

米.note: Picture of rice grains around a stalk: rice.

秘.note: 禾 grain + 必 bì (sound): secret.

etymology.hint: A mark made by a pen ⺺

书.note: A hand holding a writing brush: book, writing.

面.note: Picture of a face; also stands for flour/noodles (from 麵).

条.note: 夂 + 木 tree: a twig, long thin things.

etymology.hint: A name called out 口 to hail someone at night 夕

名.note: 夕 evening + 口 mouth: in the dark you call out your name.

明.definition: bright, clear; to explain, to understand, to shed light

etymology.hint: The light of the sun 日 and moon 月

明.note: 日 sun + 月 moon: bright.

摩.definition: to scour, to rub, to grind; friction
摩.note: 麻 má (sound) + 手 hand: to rub. Used for sound in 摩托车 (moto).

托.definition: to raise, to support; to entrust, to rely on

etymology.hint: Using one's hands 扌 for support 乇; 乇 also provides the pronunciation

托.note: 扌 hand + 乇: to hold up. Used for sound in 摩托车.

哪.note: 口 mouth + 那 nà: the question form of 那, which?

那.note: That. Add 口 and it becomes the question 哪 (which?).

些.note: 此 this + 二: some, a few.

etymology.hint: Someone who can work 力 the farm 田

男.note: 田 field + 力 strength: the one who works the field, male.

etymology.hint: A hand 又 trying to grasp at a bird 隹

难.note: 又 hand + 隹 bird: trying to catch a bird, difficult.

呢.definition: wool; interrogative or emphatic final particle
呢.note: 口 mouth + 尼 ní (sound): a particle (你呢? = and you?).

etymology.hint: Pronoun 尔 for a person 亻

你.note: 亻 person + 尔 ěr (old word for "you"): you.

们.definition: plural marker for pronouns and some nouns
们.note: 亻 person + 门 mén (sound): plural for people.

etymology.hint: You 你 said with affection 心

您.note: 你 + 心 heart: "you" said with respect.

etymology.hint: A woman turned to the side

女.note: Picture of a kneeling woman: woman, female.

欧.note: 区 qū + 欠: used for Europe.

朋.note: Two 月 side by side: companions.

etymology.hint: Two hands 又 joined, representing friendship; 又 also provides the pronunciation

啤.note: 口 mouth + 卑 bēi (sound): beer.

便.note: 亻 person + 更 gèng: convenient (biàn); in 便宜 it's pián.

宜.definition: fitting, proper, right; what one should do

etymology.hint: A memorial service 且 held in a house 宀

板.definition: board, plank; plate, slab; unnatural, stiff
板.note: 木 wood + 反 fǎn (sound): a board.

苹.note: 艹 plant + 平 píng (sound): apple.

etymology.hint: Fruit 田 growing on a tree 木

果.note: Fruit 田 on a tree 木.

七.note: A horizontal stroke cut by a bent one: seven. Don't confuse with 匕.

etymology.hint: Liquid 氵 gas 气; 气 also provides the pronunciation

汽.note: 氵 water + 气 qì (sound): steam.

钱.note: 钅 metal + 戋 jiān (sound): money (coins were metal).

轻.note: 车 cart + 𢀖: light, not heavy.

请.definition: to ask, to request; to invite; please
请.note: 讠 speech + 青 qīng (sound): please, to invite.

问.definition: to ask about, to inquire after
问.note: 口 mouth at the 门 door: to ask.

取.definition: to take, to receive, to obtain; to select

etymology.hint: A hand 又 taking the ear 耳 of a fallen enemy

取.note: 耳 ear + 又 hand: taking an ear (a war trophy), to take.

去.definition: to go away, to leave, to depart

etymology.hint: Jade 玉 put away 入 for safe-keeping

全.note: 入 + 王 jade: whole, complete.

etymology.hint: The legs of a human being

人.note: Picture of a person's two legs: person.

etymology.hint: An eye 巳 pierced by a dagger 戈, an old mark of slavery
